raw_products.bookDescription: Reel in a little calm. Reel Calm is a fishing coloring book for adults, with 40 clean, detailed designs that are a real pleasure to color. Bass, trout, salmon, catfish, pike, and saltwater favorites like redfish, tarpon, and mahi-mahi are all here, drawn with crisp, realistic lines and plenty of room to color, detailed enough to feel grown-up but never cramped or overwhelming.Every page also teaches you something. Under each fish is a short, true fun fact, so you relax and pick up a little fishing knowledge at the same time. It is the perfect quiet-time gift for the angler in your life, for a dad, grandpa, or fishing buddy, and a gentle, satisfying book for beginners and older colorists too.Inside you will find: 40 single-sided designs so colors will not bleed through, one fun fact on every page, freshwater and saltwater fish drawn in clean, realistic detail, and a roomy 8.5 by 11 inch page.
